settings.label: Which list
settings.description: The profile's watchlist, the films it has watched, or one of its lists by name.

settings.label: List name
settings.description: The last part of letterboxd.com/<user>/list/<name>/ — for example imdb-top-250. You can paste the whole address.

settings.label: How many films
settings.description: The canvas asks for this many at a time and loads more as you scroll.

settings.label: Letterboxd username
settings.description: The public profile whose watchlist and lists this plugin reads. The helper keeps it on this computer, and the profile has to be public.

auth.note: Enter the public Letterboxd username to read. No password, session or token is involved: the helper checks the name against letterboxd.com here and keeps it on this computer; nothing about it reaches your account.
